info.description: Enterprise-grade E2E Postman Suite for the IT License Registry Service Domain (BIAN-aligned, ADR-001/005/013/019/030/031/032/033). Registers a licence (a product, the unit a seat is counted in, the seats bought, the warning use, the reporting interval, an optional vendor), reads and lists it with filters, reports counts of seats in use (the same moment again is 200 with the stored report; a late count is stored but never moves the latest back), watches the licence go OK, NEAR_LIMIT and OVER_LIMIT with the seats available (negative when over), lists by level, lists and reads the reports, updates the seats bought, pauses and resumes it (a paused licence is not judged), sees a quiet tool become stale, and reads the audit ledger in order. A second folder proves the service is staff only (403 ERR-LIC-00403 for a REQUESTER on every route). A third covers the negative guarantees: validation (blank or long product, unknown unit, seats, warning and interval out of range, a malformed vendor id, missing executor or tenant, negative, non-integer or missing counts, a count from the future, a moment that cannot be read), duplicates (409), illegal transitions, tenant isolation, unknown filters, list limits and the absence of DELETE, with RFC 7807 error_code assertions. It files everything under its own generated tenant id (licOrganisationId).
